guards.what: G1 (LIVE): the +15 rest-site heal is not merely unimplemented -- there is no sim hook it could live in
guards.issue: MECHANISM: C# computes the heal as `Hook.ModifyRestSiteHealAmount(runState, creature, GetBaseHealAmount(creature))` where the base is `MaxHp * 0.3m` (HealRestSiteOption.cs:60-63, 90-93), dispatches it over the whole run's listeners (Hook.cs:1936-1944), and only then calls CreatureCmd.Heal with the result (HealRestSiteOption.cs:106-113). RegalPillow.cs:19-26 adds 15 in that chain. The sim's RunState.rest_site_heal_amount (run.py:307-309) is a bare `max_hp * 3 // 10` with no hook loop, and `Relic` declares no modify_rest_site_heal_amount member -- so this is a BASE-CLASS omission, like the is_allowed gate sweep B found, not a one-relic stub. REACHABILITY (LIVE, both sides ported, executed -- `py audit/tools/relic_probes_b13.py regal-pillow`): with the relic held, `rest_site_heal_amount()` is 24 and `rest_heal()` heals 24, identical to a run with no relics, where C# heals 24 + 15 = 39. Regal Pillow is Common in the transcribed shared grab bag and the rest-site heal path is fully ported and driven (RunState.rest_heal, run.py:1089-1095, called from driver.py:518), so nothing further is needed. SECOND CALLER worth knowing for the fix: MendRestSiteOption.cs:58 runs the same hook over the same base, so a fix placed in RunState.rest_site_heal_amount covers both. TRUNCATION NOTE: C# adds 15 to the untruncated `MaxHp * 0.3m` and the sim truncates first; for an integer +15 the two coincide at every max HP, so the fix does not need to move the floor. NOTE per binding rule 7: run.py, driver.py, HealRestSiteOption.cs, MendRestSiteOption.cs and Hook.cs are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: N1: the port's stated premise -- 'an out-of-combat rest-site effect, so this is a no-op stub' (regal_pillow.py:8-9)

The sim does have an out-of-combat rest site: RunState.rest_heal, rest_upgrade, rest_site_options and rest_heal_rewards all exist and the driver surfaces them (driver.py:512-521), and two of Relic's rest-site hooks are dispatched today (after_rest_site_heal at run.py:1094, modify_rest_site_options at run.py:1062-1073 -- relic/pumpkin_candle in this same batch uses the latter). What is genuinely absent is the ONE hook this relic needs. So the stub is not defensible as 'the sim has no rest site', and it is not a waiver under binding rule 1 either; it is the dormant-vs-live question G1 settles by execution. Carries G1's verdict.

guards.what: N2: `creature.Player != base.Owner && creature.PetOwner != base.Owner` (RegalPillow.cs:21-24) -- the heal hook is per-CREATURE, not per-player
guards.rationale: The PetOwner clause exists so a player's PET is healed by its owner's Regal Pillow. The sim has no pet creatures at a rest site at all -- RunState.rest_heal heals the run's single HP pool -- and pets are event-relic content (Relic.adds_pet exists for Pael's Legion's gate, relics/base.py:89-91, but no pet creature is modelled). Waived as a multiplayer/pet-scope omission rather than filed as a gap because the divergent thing is which creatures exist, not what the relic does; a fix for G1 that adds +15 to the run's single heal is complete for the sim's scope. Recorded so a future pet port revisits it.
